operators.name: concat_forward

parameters.name: inputs
parameters.shape: list of tensors, each [batch, channels, height, width]

semantics: Corresponds to reference statement: x = torch.cat(x, dim=1).
Concatenates all tensors in the list along dimension dim (must be 1 for this task).
All input tensors must have the same shape except in the concatenating dimension.
Output tensor is allocated on the same device as inputs (CUDA).
Requires that input tensors are on CUDA; CPU tensors should be moved by caller if necessary.
No broadcasting; exact concatenation preserves order of tensors in the list.

operators.name: softmax_forward
semantics: Corresponds to reference statement: x = self.softmax(x) with softmax dim=1.
Computes softmax along the specified dimension (dim=1 for this task).
Numerically stable: subtract max along dim before exponentiation.
Output has same shape, dtype, device as input.
Preserves memory layout (contiguous output expected).
Operates per batch element independently across spatial dimensions.
Concatenates the list of tensors x along dimension 1.
Assuming x is a list of two tensors of shape [16,8,512,1000], output shape is [16,16,512,1000].
Output is on CUDA (since execution device is CUDA).
Applies softmax over dimension 1 of the concatenated tensor.
Input shape [16,16,512,1000]; output same shape.
Softmax computed independently for each batch and spatial location.
Returns the softmax output tensor.
Shape [16,16,512,1000], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
